ADR 0028: effective ordinary GPU limits execute; the two MetalFX temporal scale selectors require a real native MetalFX scaler and supported scale-range producer.
ADRs 0004/0028: these limits select the same excluded one-dimensional, volume and cube image roles as TextureType; the strictly two-dimensional image API has no such allocation or view.

Trigger: native MetalFX temporal scaler integration with owned temporal input/output textures, executing viewport consumer and actual supported minimum/maximum scale query. Vulkan physical-device limits do not supply that scaler range.
